name: A Delver
title: Of the Day-Shift
examine: Ash on the boots, chalk on the hands, a tally string with a knot for every trip below. Paid by the basket. The baskets are heavy.
lines: Mithril day. You can smell it, sweet, like rain on a griddle.
Knot on the string going down, knot coming up. Even knots is a good life.
The Hewers never stopped working. Some mornings I know just how they feel.
